title: This week in Ootle Lobby: One good loop
description: Explore the One good loop challenge, upcoming creator prompts and resources for a small build.

calendar.title: One good loop
calendar.brief: Make one satisfying action lead to a clear result. Ship a tiny playable game or useful app, with a short demo.
calendar.evidence: A published project version, a working demo and a clear success condition.

calendar.title: Make it yours
calendar.brief: Riff an existing creation into something recognizably your own. Credit its creator and explain your changes.
calendar.evidence: Source project and version, your published version, and a before/after demonstration.

calendar.title: Better together
calendar.brief: Combine two useful parts, or collaborate with another creator to make something neither part could do alone.
calendar.evidence: Component credits, setup instructions and a demo of the parts working together.

calendar.title: Listen, then improve
calendar.brief: Let someone try your project. Pick one friction point and release an improvement based on their feedback.
calendar.evidence: Consented feedback, before/after versions and evidence the core task became easier.

editorialChecklist: Check current calendar dates and source freshness.
Select relevant resources; inspect each resource and its setup requirements.
Write original explanatory copy and a clear creator next step.
Verify claims, credit contributors and attach a distinct cover.
Review metadata, internal links, accessibility and mobile layout.
Set reviewedAt, publishedAt and status only after editorial review; put the completed article in content/blog.
